profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer in Reliability Engineering at Airbnb
profile.summary:
A software engineer with industry experience in a wide array of technologies and applications,  I have a passion for creating well-crafted software that provides value to its users. 

My experience includes a broad range of applications including enterprise class software services used by major corporations for mission critical applications. I have worked building custom software for numerous clients with broad user bases.

I have a deep interest in the technology community including contributing to open source,
promoting technical events and participating in technical conferences. I believe in software development processes which promote openness and cooperation between software developers and product owners.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: The design and implementation of a customer facing product.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Contract software development for clients including Intuit and Lytro. My duties included engineering software applications for use by client and their customers in technologies which included Ruby on Rails, jQuery and iOS.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Software development and maintenance of Steton's products. My tasks included new feature development, bug triage and build management in technologies including C#.NET, C++ and ASP.

positions.title: Lead CIT Lab Assistant and Teacher's Assistant
positions.description: Management and maintenance of Dixie State College's Computer and Information Technology computer labs. My duties included managing other assistants, maintaining software on several hundred workstations and assisting students with coursework as well as grading completed coursework.

projects.title: MTI Connect
projects.description: MTI Connect is an IoT project to improve security, analytics and usability in retail.

projects.title: GoBe Games
projects.description: A application to gamify charity by rewarding positive contribution. This project eventually formed the basis of several similar applications aimed at rewarding contributions to your community.
